search.snippet: The pie dish is an item that players use to make pies using the Cooking skill. Players must add pastry dough to the dish to make a pie shell. It can then be filled with various fillings (see pie for more details). A pie is a type of food that players can make with the Cooking skill. It takes two bites to eat, leaving an empty pie dish which can be reused. Garden pie is a type of pie that restores 12 Hitpoints in total, 2 bites each healing for 6. It also temporarily boosts Farming by 3. A pie dish will remain after both bites are consumed.

intelligence.economy_brief: The OSRS market is in a normal patch window with subdued price pressure and elevated breadth. Turnover is modestly positive while liquidity stress remains elevated, and the shallowest book depth is concentrated in high-spread, low-volume names.
intelligence.market_mood: Cautious and range-bound; participants are prioritizing cost of entry and fill probability over aggressive reversion, producing low-volatility, low-alpha conditions.
intelligence.regime: Normal patch window (not an update cycle); deterministic news flow is quiet, macro/microstructure metrics indicate a compressed risk-appetite regime.

Current regime favors strategies with tight spread capture, low inventory risk, and high fill probability.
